description.value: Eagle Bluff Bed & Breakfast is a waterfront B&B established in 1990 in Prince Rupert's historic Cow Bay district, offering six uniquely appointed guest rooms and harbour and mountain views from a signature western cedar oceanside deck. An on-site chef-manager prepares a full home-cooked breakfast served in a second-floor dining room overlooking the ocean. Situated at the northern BC ferry terminal connecting to Haida Gwaii and the Alaska Marine Highway, it is a natural staging point for cyclists making long-haul coastal connections.
